description: Partial demolition of existing restaurant and redevelopment to create commercial retail use (A1, A2, A3, B1, D1) on ground & basement floor with 9 residential apartments and basement car parking
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until a survey of the existing ground levels has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The ground levels shall not be raised or otherwise altered from those shown on the submitted plan, without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted has commenced, a method statement and scheme of construction practice shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:
(i)	any illumination of the site during construction
(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site
(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties
(iv)	considerate contractor scheme
(v)	boundary treatment for the construction site
(vi)	details of size and location of construction compound
The construction scheme so approved should be fully implemented prior to commencement of construction operations.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of facilities for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and implemented in accordance with such approval prior to first occupation of any part of the development.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the buildings hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 8 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority in writing.
Condition : 9 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 0800 to 1800 Mondays to Saturdays, nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 10 - The development hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing and collection of refuse or waste and recycling for both the residential and commercial uses have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing and collection of domestic and commercial refuse or waste and recycling shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the development hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 11 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and any works that form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.

Condition : 12 - Before development is commenced full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the commercial units, residential units and car park against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given. This acoustic insulation shall ensure the maximum noise level to be permitted within dwellings with the windows shut and any other necessary means of ventilation provided shall not exceed the "good" limits contained in BS 8233:1999 these being Laeq16hour=30dB in living rooms, Laeq 8 hour =30dB and LAFMAX=45 db in bedrooms

Condition : 13 - Development shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours for both the residential and restaurant premises, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 14 - Development shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the restaurant and residential premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 15 - Details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, before the development is commenced, for a scheme of ventilation for habitable rooms of the dwellings on the facades where an excess of 40 ugm-3 NO2, predicted by a dispersion model with verification as described in LAQM TG 03, to ensure the level of air pollution in these rooms does not exceed the NO2 National Air Quality Objective and EU Limit Values.

Condition : 16 - Details of the shopfronts proposed, including elevations, materials and sections shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing and approved prior to commencement of any part of this development. Installation of the proposed shopfront shall be completed prior to occupation of the residential development hereby approved in writing.

Condition : 17 - Details of the measures proposed on the site to reduce the carbon emissions by 20% of the predicted energy requirements of the residential development hereby approved shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing prior to commencement of development, and the development thereby approved shall be implemented accordingly

Condition : 18 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority for a scheme of reducing carbon emissions from the total energy needs (heat, cooling, power) the residential component of the development by at least 20% by the on-site generation of renewable energy

Condition : 19 - No development shall take place until details of measures for the harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run off from the building and the conservation and re-use as appropriate of other water supplies in the building have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be carried out as approved in writing.

Condition : 20 - The commercial uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times (8am-11pm Mon-Sat, 9am-10.30pm Sun) and customers to have left the premises within 30 minutes of closing.

Condition : 21 - The premises shall be used for A1, A2, A3 use classes only and for no other A use class purpose (including use class A5 Takeaway, either in part or as a whole unit) of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 22 - No refuse collection shall take place outside the hours of 8am-6pm Monday to Saturday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
Condition : 23 - Dining or drinking shall not take place anywhere on the site except within the building. No dining is to take place on the pavement.

Condition : 24 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 25 - No work or associated activities including deliveries /loading /unloading /servicing /or parking or manoeuvring of vehicles by staff and/or visitors shall be carried out on the premises on any Sunday or Bank Holiday nor before 8am or after 6pm on Monday - Friday nor before 8am or after 1pm on Saturdays.
Condition : 26 - No plumbing or pipes other than rainwater pipes shall be fixed to the external faces of the building(s).
Condition : 27 - No building, structure, plant or other apparatus shall be erected, placed or fixed to any part of the roof or the external faces of the building.
Condition : 28 - The roof of the building shall not be used for any purpose other than as a means of escape in emergency or for maintenance of the building.
Condition : 29 - The parking  hereby permitted shall be clearly marked out on site and be used only for purposes of vehicle parking by the occupiers of or visitors to the premises.

Condition : 30 - No playing of musical instruments or operation of sound amplification equipment shall take place in any part of the premises open to the public, before 11 am, nor after 11 pm, on any day/at any time so as to be audible outside the premises.
Condition : 31 - Staff shall not be present on any commercial portion of the premises after a period of 60 minutes has elapsed following the approved closing times.

Condition : 32 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the building is occupied or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 33 - The development permitted by this planning permission shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) (Q developments February 2009) and the following mitigation measures detailed within the FRA:

1. Internal access from all flats be available to a area of dry refuge.

2. Access from the basement level to areas of dry refuge will be available at all times.

Condition : 34 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 35 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme must be agreed in writing by the local planning authority indicating further details of the platform lift proposed including the actual type of platform lift, the dimensions of the lifting mechanism and the means of control to ensure it meets appropriate disability standards.
Condition : 36 - No commercial unit shall be greater than 220m2 in total for D1 use.

Condition : 37 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the townhouses or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 38 - The ground floor and roof terraces shown on approved drawing numbers 200 B and 201 B shall be retained as private amenity space.  They shall be permanently maintained as open space for the use, benefit and recreation of persons residing in the development hereby permitted.
